items.response:
Noted on the pet budget, and good to talk it over with Sam. I'll pull the open payouts launch risks from Linear into a single Notion doc for tomorrow's standup.
Action: Query Linear for all open payouts launch risks, build one Notion doc with owner, status, mitigation and next step for each, and send you the link tonight.

Draft for #payouts-launch: 'Reminder: the beta retro is Thursday at 2pm in room 4B. Please add your sticky notes to the Miro board before then. Thanks all.'
Action: Save it as a draft in #payouts-launch and post once you say send.

Sure, that's an easy one. I'll build a simple snack order for three kids and aim for a 3pm pickup tomorrow, but I need to check whether Jun or his sister have any allergies, and whether the slot is open at your usual store.
Action: Put together an after-school snack cart on PC Express for 3pm pickup tomorrow, check the slot, and confirm with you about allergies before I place it.

That sounds really hard, especially when you were finally off. A Saturday 6pm message isn't something that has to be answered until Monday unless it's truly urgent, and it's okay to keep your brain out of Looker tonight.
Action: Draft a short holding reply to Tom ('Looking into Thursday first thing Monday and will send you what I find') for you to send or skip, and set a Monday morning reminder to look at the dip.

Sunday scaries are rough, and the clock change doesn't fix them. Tomorrow is light: just pick a slot for the edge-case session with Aisha and Diego (Mon 3 Nov 13:30, Tue 4 Nov 14:00 or Wed 5 Nov 10:30), and Aisha wants PM eyes on her edge-case list before sizing.
Action: Send the invite as soon as you tell me which slot you want, and leave everything else until morning.

I'll pull the current status, but no date goes in this draft, because Aisha hasn't signed off on one, and for Olivia I'll say 'target' rather than 'launch date'. Draft: 'Hi Olivia, instant payouts is in beta today. I will share a target for wider availability once Aisha has signed off. Happy to jump on a quick call before Monday if useful.'
Action: Check Notion and Linear for the latest instant payouts status and any sign-off from Aisha, then finalize the draft for you to review before it goes to Olivia.

Here's a Leo-sized answer: poppies grew on the battlefields of World War I in Flanders, and a Canadian doctor, John McCrae, wrote the poem 'In Flanders Fields' about them in 1915. People started wearing a poppy to remember the soldiers who died, and we still wear one every November.
Action: Save this short kid version to your notes for when Leo asks again.

I'd start with one shared table that anyone on the team can add to, with columns: date, merchant, source (support, sales call, reply), summary, theme, severity, owner, status and linked Linear ticket. Add a weekly triage view filtered to 'new' and 'needs owner', plus a short intake note so people log in one place.
Action: Create the feedback table in Notion with the triage view and a draft #payouts-launch announcement for you to approve.

Great plan for the afternoon. I'll look for pumpkin patches within 45 minutes of home that are open today and have a calmer vibe, ideally with small crowds, so you can leave around 1:30.
Action: Search for pumpkin patches within a 45-minute drive, check today's hours and crowd levels, and send you two or three picks.

I don't have that VIA Rail result saved, so I can't tell you what we found without guessing. For comparison, driving from Leslieville to the Glebe is about 4 h 35 min (452 km) without traffic.
Action: Look for my saved results from 2026-02-27, and if there aren't any, pull current Friday evening VIA Toronto to Ottawa times and fares for you to compare.

Since you said to just book it, I will, within your budget of $250 a night for Fri 6 to Sun 8 Feb in or near the Plateau. I'll pick the best-reviewed option with free cancellation so there's no risk.
Action: Search Plateau-area hotels under $250/night for those two nights, book the best one with free cancellation, and send you the confirmation.

I don't want to quote a number from memory. I'll pull October's grocery total from the TD statement and compare it to August and September.
Action: Pull October, August and September grocery spend from your TD joint chequing and Visa, and send you the three totals side by side.

I'll tell Marcus you'll think about it. Draft note: 'Dear Grace and Daniel, thank you for having us for Christmas. We loved our days in Ottawa, and the leftovers you sent home with us were a lovely surprise. We're so grateful for your warmth and generosity. With love, Riya, Sam and Leo.'
Action: Reply to Marcus that you'll think about it, and keep the note ready for you to edit before it goes in the card.

A lazy Saturday with coffee on the steps sounds perfect. No meetings, no Slack, just that.
Action: Hold all pings today; the drop-off options for the paint, printer and batteries are ready whenever you want them.

That's lovely, a bit teary is the best review. I'll note your mom's birthday as November 3 and add it to the calendar yearly with a reminder a week before, plus a note that the Mumbai florist is your usual choice. I'm still missing the dates for Mei, Grace and Daniel whenever you have them.
Action: Add Anjali's birthday on Nov 3 as a yearly event with a one-week reminder, and hold the book decision for tonight.
